items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: So we used him on a record date, John and I. He played “Sing Sing Sing”

ctx.x: I don’t know, he gave me the impression that you helped him not get in trouble.

Yeah, well, in other words, when I heard him play on a ship he was playing in a jam session one night. I said, “who the hell is that drummer?” It was Pretty Purdie. And he was swinging. So we used him on a record date, John and I. He played “Sing Sing Sing” — it was unbelievable. He knew it backwards.
All right, I’m going to try another tune on you here. I’m just going to give you —
